layout.name: Nürburgring · full Nordschleife
layout.widthNote: Conservative authored usable corridor at the minimum retained mapped width tag of the selected ways (7 metres). These OSM width tags are geographic observations, not an independent pavement-edge survey. Original varying widths remain in source tags.
layout.timingNote: The full loop includes the T13 source section and its five mapped bridges. This source alone does not establish a surveyed timing line, tourist bridge-to-gantry course, GP course or combined endurance layout. Game records must remain separate from official venue records.
layout.lengthNote: Mapped two-dimensional geodesic centreline length is retained separately from the venue reference specification. No stretching to the official lap distance; 3D surface-length and timing-line reconciliation remain part of playable-pack acceptance.
